name: freqtrade-strategies Strategy005
translation_notes: Uses the strategy's own hyperopt results (buy_params / sell_params) as the parameter values. Entry: volume above 4x its 150-bar average, close below SMA(40), RSI(14) above 26, and Fisher-RSI-normalised below 5; the latter is 50 x (tanh(0.1 x (RSI - 50)) + 1) < 5, which is exactly RSI < 35.28. Dropped from the entry: fast stochastic fastd > fastk and fastd > 1 (no stochastic), and a minimum-price guard (irrelevant for BTC). Exit (the hyperopt-selected 'rsi-macd-minusdi' trigger): RSI(14) crosses above 74 and the MACD(12, 26, 9) line is below 0; the third condition, minus-DI > 4, is dropped (no DMI in the registry; it is true almost always). The ROI table (0 min: 5%, 20: 4%, 40: 3%, 80: 2%, 1440: 1%) becomes a single 5% take-profit. Stop-loss 10% kept. Timeframe changed 5m -> 1h. Four features and six params, both at the plan limit.
